name: spotlight
title: Spotlight
description: A soft primary-tinted light that follows the pointer across a card, with an optional glow on the nearest edge.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the light in pixels.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Strength of the light, from 0 to 1.

props.name: border
props.description: Also lights the edge nearest the pointer, even from a neighbouring card.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the light off. On touch devices and under reduced motion it rests at the top instead.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the surface. Rounded corners are inherited by the light.
